description: ED visit occurred 5 days ago → 10 days ago
presentation: A 34-year-old man presents for follow-up after an emergency department visit 10 days ago for palpitations, tachycardia, arm numbness, and a sensation of tightness in the neck, thought to be due to stress/anxiety as he has been getting poor sleep due to international travel and jet lag. He had a negative troponin, normal TSH, and normal A1c, but his LDL was 200. What interventions should be done for this patient?
